Language of the settings screens: 简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語
This Android version follows the system language. Tap to open system language settings

For now only the settings home page and the prediction model choice are translated; other pages still show Simplified Chinese until a later version. This changes only the screen text, not your input languages.
Which one? Most phones: Full (better predictions). Phones with under 4 GB of memory or little free space: Lite (half the size). You only need one; both are fast.

During phone calls and WeChat voice or video calls, shows what the other person says as captions at the bottom of the screen; they disappear when you hang up. Needs speakerphone. Audio is recognized only on this device: nothing is recorded or uploaded, and the screen content is not read.
